member.name: P:Sandbox.SimpleTextChat.FontSize
member.summary: Font size of chat messages in pixels.

member.name: P:Sandbox.SimpleTextChat.LineHeight
member.summary: Height of each line of chat text in pixels. Also controls spacing between messages.

member.name: P:Sandbox.SimpleTextChat.NameColor
member.summary: Color of the player name displayed before each message.

member.name: P:Sandbox.SimpleTextChat.TextColor
member.summary: Color of the chat message body text.

member.name: P:Sandbox.SimpleTextChat.InputTextColor
member.summary: Color of the text you type in the input box.

member.name: P:Sandbox.SimpleTextChat.LogBoxColor
member.summary: Background color of the chat log box (only visible when chat is open).

member.name: P:Sandbox.SimpleTextChat.InputBoxColor
member.summary: Background color of the text input box.

member.name: P:Sandbox.SimpleTextChat.LogHeight
member.summary: Height of the chat log box in pixels. Controls how many lines are visible at once.

member.name: P:Sandbox.SimpleTextChat.BoxWidth
member.summary: Width of the chat log and input boxes in pixels.

member.name: P:Sandbox.SimpleTextChat.HistorySize
member.summary: Maximum number of chat messages kept in memory. Oldest are removed when exceeded.

member.name: P:Sandbox.SimpleTextChat.MessageLifetime
member.summary: How long in seconds a chat message stays fully visible before it starts fading out.

member.name: P:Sandbox.SimpleTextChat.FadeDuration
member.summary: How long in seconds the fade-out transition takes after MessageLifetime expires.
